name: data-table
title: Data table
description: Sticky uppercase header, hairline rows, gold row hover, numeric columns right-aligned. The wrapper scrolls sideways with a visible scrollbar on wide tables.
whenToUse: Any tabular data. Put it in a card with tx-card__body--flush, add tx-pagination in the card footer. Use tx-table--dense for long lists and tx-table--lines for column lines.

variants.description: Scrolling frame. Set --tx-table-h to fix the height (sticky header scrolls inside).
Cell class: right-aligned tabular figures (header follows).
First column frozen while scrolling sideways.

a11y: Use <th scope="col">. Give the table a <caption> (it can be visually hidden with tx-sr-only). Sortable headers use a button inside the th and aria-sort on the th.
